interface.title: Dilution Protocol Generator (Ver 3.2)
interface.field: Wet-lab pharmacology / cell biology: preparing compound solutions
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment planning and bench preparation, before treating cells or plates
interface.what_it_is_for: It turns a list of target compound concentrations, volumes, a solvent/diluent stage scheme and a solubility limit into a multi-tube serial-dilution protocol, a stock-weighing summary, a material list and a 96-well plate layout, all of which can be exported for the bench.

data.note: No data files. I typed in an example compound: ALA, MW 167.59 g/mol, solubility 50 mg/mL then 1 mg/mL then 30 mM, targets 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 in µM and later nM. The page starts with a built-in protocol scheme of 100% DMSO → 5% (add PBS) → 0.5% (add Medium) and three plate groups (Control, Vehicle, Treatment). Setup: the page opens in Traditional Chinese; the English language toggle was pressed before working (screens/004.webp) and pressed again after later edits. With the observer fix, translation runs only once, so content generated later stays partly in Chinese until the English button is pressed again; even then some strings stay mixed (stage labels, alerts, CSV headers). Typing, changing units, adding or removing stages, ticking boxes and clicking wells never froze the page.

features.name: Stage-chain solvent composition editor with tube diagrams
features.general: Define a chain of preparation stages, each with a target percentage of the original solvent and a named diluent; the tool shows each tube's makeup and the overall dilution factor
features.specific: Eppendorf stage editor: red % box per stage, blue stock-solvent box (synced to all stages), yellow 'Add' diluent box, + Add stage / × remove; the 'Current protocol' line shows e.g. 100% DMSO → 5% → 0.5% (total 200×)
steps: Type the stock solvent name in the first stage
Set the final % for each later stage
Name the diluent added before each stage
Add or remove stages
Read the per-step and total dilution factors and the colour-coded tube composition
serves_tasks: Set the solvent and the diluent added at each stage
Add or remove a dilution stage
Work out the required stock concentration

features.name: Stock concentration and solubility check
features.general: Calculate the stock concentration needed from the highest target and total dilution, convert the solubility limit by molecular weight, and flag a stock that is above solubility or below the requirement
features.specific: Section 1: Auto-required starting concentration, Maximum solubility in mg/mL or mM, optional 'Specify common stock concentration/volume'; red alerts 'exceeds max solubility' or 'lower than required minimum'
steps: Enter molecular weight and solubility with its unit
Read the auto-required stock concentration
Optionally fix your own stock concentration and volume
Generate and read the pass (summary with converted limit) or the red alert
serves_tasks: Check whether the required stock exceeds the solubility limit
Override the stock concentration and/or volume
Work out the required stock concentration

features.name: Automatic intermediate-dilution planner
features.general: Given a maximum fold per step and a minimum transfer volume, split any too-large dilution into easy sub-steps and insert intermediate tubes
features.specific: Max dilution factor + Min transfer volume + 'Auto-plan when limit is exceeded'; the AUTO panel lists stage expansions (20× → 5× × 4×) and stock-to-start splits (e.g. 1,250× → 5×·5×·8×·6.25× with I1-1/I1-2/I1-3 when targets are in nM against a 25 mM stock); an expanded protocol strip shows AUTO tubes P1, P2
steps: Set the maximum dilution factor
Set the minimum transfer volume
Leave Auto-plan on (or off to get a blocking error)
Generate and review the AUTO plan and the expanded protocol strip
serves_tasks: Limit the per-step dilution factor and the minimum transfer volume, and let the tool insert intermediate dilutions
Require every step to stay within the dilution limit (no automatic intermediates)

features.name: Per-target serial-dilution procedure with back-calculated volumes
features.general: For each target, show the chain of tubes with source, transfer and diluent volumes, totals and leftovers, worked back from the final usable volume plus a reserve; also total the materials
features.specific: Preparation procedure: tube cards (T1-1, AUTO I1-1 …) with 'Transfer X µL + Y µL diluent', per-target table (factor, total µL, ratio, used/remaining), Solution preparation summary (compound mass, stock volume) and Total materials required. Only the reserve was changed in this run; the usable volume per target stayed at its default (untested)
steps: Set the extra reserve per tube (usable volume per target left at default; changing it was not tested)
Generate
Read the stock prep summary and mass to weigh
Read the total materials and usage by target
Follow the tube chains per target
serves_tasks: Generate the full per-target dilution procedure with volumes, worked back from the usable volume needed per target
Account for reserve volume in the stock and tube volumes

features.name: 96-well plate group painter
features.general: Define coloured groups and paint them onto plate wells by click or drag, erase wells, and keep an assigned-well count
features.specific: Group chips (colour, name, ×), Eraser mode, + Add group, click/drag over wells A1–H12, 'Assigned N / 96'; select a group by clicking the chip's edge, not its name field
steps: Add or rename a group
Select the group chip
Click or drag across wells to assign them
Use Eraser mode to clear wells
Delete a group to clear its wells
serves_tasks: Assign wells to groups by clicking or dragging
